title: Onboarding validation flow and pin-propagator for quant artifacts
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build an automated onboarding and validation flow for quantization artifacts (INT8 / FP8 / GPTQ / AWQ) that ends-to-end verifies functional parity, latency/cost budgets, and pin-propagation semantics. Deliver a 'pin-propagator' component that ensures newly published quant artifacts carry a deterministic pin manifest and can be safely referenced by rollout policies. This ticket scopes the engineering work: validation harness, acceptance metric set, canary gating logic, and integration points with the pin registry and console publishing UI.
acceptance_criteria: New quant artifact ingestion triggers an automated validation run that executes functional (sample-suite), perf (p50/p95/p99), and cost regression checks against a baseline unquantized or pinned variant.
Pin-propagator produces a pin manifest (model_version, quant_profile_hash, kernel_fingerprint, supported_sequence_ranges) and signs it for registry ingestion.
Canary gating rejects a publish if any functional fidelity metric degrades beyond configurable thresholds or latency SLO exceeds budget for the canary window.
Rollout policies can reference the pin manifest ID and the runtime honors that pin exactly (no background autoreplacements).
Console shows per-pin telemetry: token-per-second, p50/p95/p99 latencies, regression delta for fidelity test-suite, and cost-per-token delta.
End-to-end tests covering nondeterministic seed variance and KV-cache interactions exist and run in CI.
implementation_plan: Design: finalize pin manifest schema and signing format with product and security
Validation harness: extend existing eval runner to support quant artifacts and deterministic seed orchestration
Perf tests: add warmed-up end-to-end latency measurement harness and cost estimator for tokenized workloads
Pin-propagator service: microservice to compute manifest, fingerprint kernels, and call registry API
Canary gate: implement canary controller that consumes validation results and sets publish state
Console integration: expose pin metadata and canary verdicts in model publish flow
CI: add integration tests that simulate shadow-run canaries and assert rollback behavior
test_plan: Functional: run canonical sample-suite (50 prompts covering instruction/QA/code) and compute fidelity_loss (BLEU+embedding-sim) vs baseline
Stability: perform 5 repeated runs with different RNG seeds; assert inter-run variance below tolerance
Latency: synthetic trace with real payloads; measure warm and cold p50/p95/p99 across sequence lengths
KV-cache regression: replay multi-turn chat scenarios and assert token-latency scaling is within profile
Cost: compute cost-per-token delta using runtime batching assumptions and current kernel selections
End-to-end publish simulation: ingest artifact -> run validator -> pin manifest -> attempt publish -> verify console state
metrics_and_alerts: CanaryFailureRate > 0 => alert pager for responsible eng on-call
FidelityLoss > 0.03 average across sample-suite => fail publish and notify PM/ML
p95_latency_delta > 15% compared to baseline => block publish
CostPerTokenIncrease > 25% => warn in console and require explicit approval
PinManifestSignFailed => send audit log and block ingestion
